title: DADA: Dialect Adaptation via Dynamic Aggregation of Linguistic Rules

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance disparities on natural language understanding tasks (e.g., MNLI, GLUE benchmark) by comparing a model's accuracy on Standard American English (SAE) against its accuracy on synthetically generated dialectal variants (such as African American Vernacular English, Appalachian English, Chicano English, Colloquial Singapore English, and Indian English) created using specific linguistic transformation rules.
